effect.maledict.age_of_darkness.descript: O dark age that lets barbarism burn civilization: each level reduces magic resistance, Soul Ward capacity and Soul Ward integrity by 20%.
effect.maledict.age_of_enlightenment.des: People mistake ignorance and darkness for the sacred. Your melee attacks deal double damage; each level also grants 1 additional Reserve Staff Charge.
effect.maledict.blessing_of_life.descrip: The prayers of the living flow through your veins with nourishment: natural health regeneration restores an additional share.
effect.maledict.decay.description: Hostile creatures near the wearer lose half a heart every two seconds. This damage is never fatal.
effect.maledict.ripening.description: The wearer gains an extra quarter of all experience earned.
effect.maledict.sacrifice.description: Sages gave their lives in sacrifice, and thereby gained wisdom. Yet not every sacrifice brings wisdom: only by imitating the rites of the sages might one gain a sage's wisdom.
effect.maledict.thinning.description: When more than eight hostile creatures of the same type surround the wearer, those on the outskirts take 1.5 damage every two seconds.
enchantment.maledict.aftertaste.desc: When a scythe strikes, you taste the hunger and saturation that the target's drops would restore, scaled by the damage dealt as a fraction of its maximum health. Levels 1 to 3 restore 50%, 60% and 70% of that amount, respectively. Any food effects from those drops also apply.
enchantment.maledict.ectoplasm.desc: Each level increases arrow speed by 8%. Each shot consumes (level + 1) / 2 spirits from your inventory; the enchantment has no effect without enough spirits.
enchantment.maledict.reminiscence.desc: Arrows can pass through blocks once, up to a thickness of 2 + level blocks.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.corrupt_s: Where does wisdom come from? Could I truly gain a sage's wisdom by wounding myself with Tyrving in a deliberate rite, as I so foolishly hope?

Through nine days and nine nights of torment I did see something, and came to know something as well. My body has gained another place where runes may be carved, and my eyes have become a doorway. Through this sacrificial vision, I can see the world more clearly.
Survive the sacrifice to gain an additional rune slot and a vision slot.
Gathering the magic of endermen into Astral Weave can give Soulwood wondrous properties.
A bow made from this wood takes half as long to draw as an ordinary bow. Its arrows fly faster and can pass through blocks to a limited depth.
The pulse of the Rite of Decay grows sluggish when inscribed on a tablet. It slowly wears away the flesh of hostile creatures near the wearer, but cannot kill them.

I have turned the power of the Rite of Nourishment inward, strengthening my mind with what once nourished living flesh. The Rune of Ripening provides a fairly steady increase of one quarter to the experience I gain. Not much, but enough.

The Rune of Satiation is a weaker extension of the Rite of Healing. Without a sufficient field, it instead refines the energy in food to restore health. Whenever nourishment restores health, the rune restores an additional amount equal to what the food itself would provide.
The pulse of empowerment was once inscribed upon monsters. Now I have bent it back to recognize only my own pack. Companions within sixteen blocks gain Resistance I, Strength I and Speed I.
After adjusting the pattern of the runic rite, I succeeded in inscribing other aura rites onto tablets.
My earlier conclusion that only rites of the basic elements would work was not entirely correct. These pulses are simpler, so their effects differ somewhat from those of the full rites.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.void.male: I cannot move on. I cannot move on. I cannot move on. I cannot move on. I cannot move on. I cannot move on. I cannot move on.
I cannot move on. I cannot move on. I cannot move on. I cannot move on. I poured my unceasing elegy into the bow, allowing it to fire automatically at full draw.
Perhaps falling into the well shattered my fear of the forbidden. Malignant Pewter's hunger for the erosion of knowledge forged the Edge of Deliverance.

Could that rejection be transformed into an overt magical property? My earlier research reminded me that, if I could construct a dynamically stable environment, the pulses of the eight spirits might provoke the pulse of a ninth arcane energy to reveal itself.

At last I obtained this weapon. The will within the Edge of Deliverance was utterly devoured by the void. This emptiness hungers to consume everything, while the eight spirits submit entirely to its control; even their pulses are distorted, manifesting unexpected abilities.
As more spirits are offered, the weapon becomes ever more inscrutable. I have named it the Incursus Blade, and hope this void can be sated by the pulses.

Brilliance has already proven its worth. Adding more of the power condensed in Mnemonic Fragments makes their enchanting power shine brighter still, reaching the astonishing strength of ten bookshelves.
By exploiting malignant metal's rejection of magic, I can focus the power of Hallowed Gold more intensely, yielding an acceleration of one half.
But what is to be done? Whoever loves must share the fate of the one he loves. The eternal fall, without love and so without sorrow, is the final nothingness.
I am so sorrowful. I am so sorrowful. I am so sorrowful. I am so sorrowful.
One day she will leave them and depart alone, weary of the songs of heaven's angels, preferring instead to embrace the bones of mortals.
Halting evolution is pewter's defining property. When paired with consciousness, it gains a measure of direction, allowing it to halt evolution imposed from outside.

The gold of golds, the ultimate holy thing, falls into base and heavy lead. So-called malice is the embodiment of that pain. I refined that malice and made this rune of it. It lays the malice upon the other, so that every recovery of life decays into a pang of pain.
My practice differs from that of this book's original author. I have long sought to bend Malignant Pewter, an anti-magic metal, to magical use.

Building on Voidish Runecraft, I introduced variables to emphasize one aspect of the pewter while suppressing the other. Working magic through pewter is neither practical nor safe, but it is what I want.
Having gathered a great quantity of umbral spirits, I began experimenting freely with tablets already proven to work. After a few wrong turns, I produced the following tablets.

Vicissitude is not a being I can create; it is only a shadow that enters through the wound. By laws I do not know, three arcane spirits pry open a crack and four pry it wider - and what comes through that door is fate's own unwelcome guest.

Using eldritch spirits extends the reach of the Rite of Vicissitude. A more complete shadow falls upon this place, though a shadow can hardly be called complete. Two eldritch spirits summon a more complete aspect still.
malum.gui.book.entry.void.maledict.umbra: Seeking the Forbidden… Is There Any Point?
malum.gui.curio.effect.maledict.age_of_e: Cooldowns recover twice as fast while worn
Slaying an enemy grants Age of Enlightenment, or extends its duration if already active
Attacking targets at half health triggers spirit-harvesting effects
malum.gui.curio.effect.maledict.blessing: Natural health regeneration restores an additional equal amount.
malum.gui.curio.effect.maledict.bliss.da: Increases the damage dealt to and taken from those whose proportion of health differs from yours.
malum.gui.curio.effect.maledict.bliss.fo: Forces both sides' attacks to be able to land.
malum.gui.curio.effect.maledict.decay: Nearby hostile creatures lose half a heart every two seconds. This damage is never fatal.
malum.gui.curio.effect.maledict.fallen: Makes the target's healing decay into wounds.
malum.gui.curio.effect.maledict.melancho: You gradually become resistant to repeated damage of the same kind. Healing and harm alike leave you numb.
malum.gui.curio.effect.maledict.pack_boo: Your companions within sixteen blocks gain Resistance I, Strength I and Speed I.
malum.gui.curio.effect.maledict.rotten_b: If your maximum health is greater than 1, escape death at the cost of 25% of your maximum health.
message.maledict.first_vicissitude.adapt: Rigid convention, blind adherence to the old ways: Vicissitude regards them as filth.
message.maledict.first_vicissitude.attac: Fate always drives people to the edge of a cliff, like an unwelcome guest calling.
message.maledict.first_vicissitude.curio: Every confiscated curio has been returned
%s curio(s) are still in custody: free up inventory or curio slots and they will be returned automatically
message.maledict.first_vicissitude.phase: Vicissitude is the fate even sages meet while walking the righteous path.
sounds.maledict.item.incursus_blade.reca: Incursus Blade: Rending Wind and Silk, Ringing Gold and Jade
tooltip.maledict.age_of_enlightenment.ho: Hold Shift to ask a question better left unasked
tooltip.maledict.age_of_enlightenment.sh: Did an age of darkness ever exist?
O infinite, boundless, ever-turning Age of Enlightenment
tooltip.maledict.curio_return_token: Right-click to reclaim confiscated curios that are still in custody. The token only disappears once everything has been handed back.
tooltip.maledict.incursus_blade.descript: A sinister scythe that grows by devouring spirits and sweeps its blade around the wielder.
tooltip.maledict.incursus_blade.infusion: Right-click this item with spirits in the inventory to infuse them permanently:
tooltip.maledict.incursus_blade.medium_u: When spirit power reaches the sacred number, a more intrinsic power is unlocked.
tooltip.maledict.incursus_blade.spirit.a: Aerial %s%% (%s/%s): Remove random harmful effects and gain random beneficial effects
tooltip.maledict.incursus_blade.spirit.e: Eldritch %s%% (%s/%s): Convert a portion of damage into absorption up to a cap, and immediately restore Soul Ward
tooltip.maledict.incursus_blade.spirit.s: Sacred %s%% (%s/%s): Shorten enemies' beneficial effects; extend or inflict harmful effects
